title: Leaving Hirt and the daytime Roosevelt job
summary: Netto refused to follow Hirt out of town, since he was playing days at the Roosevelt, dated to around the 1960s.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: How long did you play with Jumbo?
Until he wanted to leave town and then he wanted me to leave to Roosevelt and go. I said, no, no. I said, hell no.
So you were playing during the day at the Roosevelt?

I was playing during the day. I was playing with Jordan Crest then. And then some, I said, I said, look, I said, I got a camp. I said, I can go sleep at the camp. I got a house. I said, I can go sleep at the house. And I'm going to go buy a bed in some other town. I said, and then get in, wait for the Standard Oil Company. I said, after all, they're buying gasoline, running around from here to there. So, yeah.
When was that? Was that in the 40s?
No, I think that was probably around the 60s. 60s, that late.
So you would play with Jumbo through the 50s then, huh?
